ClientResponses.Response:
Your feedback is very important to us. We are very sorry to hear you are having an issue with flare ups. We are happy to help.  

Flare ups are a byproduct of grilling over live fire. The drippings falling down create the flare ups. While they can never be eliminated completely, below are some steps for reducing them:

Cleaning your grill. I recommend cleaning your cooking grates, Flavorizer bars, burner tubes, heat deflectors (if applicable), the inside of your cookbox, and your slide out grease tray.

If using a marinade, get as much excess liquid off as possible before putting the food on the grill.

If using a sauce, wait until the last 5-10 minutes to apply.

Be sure to check out the Weber blog for grilling guides, tips, videos, and recipes.

Our Care team will be reaching out to assist you further. Please look for our outreach soon. Thank you!

Thank you for your feedback. We are sorry to learn that there is a leak somewhere causing an issue. We apologize for the frustration!

Many leaks are caused by a damaged LP tank. If the replacement hose/regulator did not fix the issue, we recommend trying a fresh tank with a clean gasket.
You can read more here: https://www.weber.com/SG/en/blog/burning-questions/lp-tank-101/weber-29662.html

Your grill has a great warranty, and our Care team will be here to help until everything is working correctly. Thank you!

The cooking surface is easily as big as previous 4 burner grills I've owned.

Results.ReviewText: I have owned and used Weber grills for 30+ years, but this is the worst grill I have owned. The grill temperature is very hard to control. My previous grill had 2 horizontal burners (front and back), and this grill the burners are vertical. Almost impossible to control the temperature. Additionally, under the grill, the hole to set the propane tank was too big and the tank actually sat on the floor. Very poor design, because the hanger that is there for the grill is useless. There is not enough room to hang a full tank.

Results.ReviewText: We had the Spirit E-210 Gas Grill for a year and loved it. Then we got caught up in a sales pitch for a smoker-grill and sold out 210 to a neighbor. Turns out we HATED the smoker-grill and it didn't do what we needed. So we bought the Spirit E-210 a second time. We're relieved to have our easy to use, easy to clean, ready in minutes, quick grilling gas grill back on our deck. We can decide to grill chicken breasts or burgers at the last minute (relatively speaking) and not make an all-day affair out of it. LOVE the Spirit E-210!
Results.Title: Love the Spirit E-210 so much we bought it twice!

Results.ReviewText: We were downsizing and hesitant on taking our Weber Genius natural gas grill with us; as well as leaving my Weber kettle behind. ;(  We shopped the Weber grills and decided on the Spirit E-210 Liquid Propane. Good choice! The size is good with plenty of grilling surface and a shelf to use as well. The drop-down side tables can be used independently, which I like.  I’ve not used cooking with the propane tank, but it was no problem and I like the weighted feature that will indicate when the tank is getting close to empty. Also I like the temperature gauge on the front, which is most helpful.   Good purchase.
Results.Title: Good size, good features

Results.ReviewText: This compact model, with dual folding side shelves, fits well on our small porch.  Very well made, handles both direct and indirect cooking very well.  Our family regularly enjoys great burgers and ribs weekly- wonderful taste.

Results.ReviewText: This grill is the perfect size for me and my wife.  I love the quick fold up/down side trays, it makes it easy to store this in my garage and not take up much space.  The propane tank gauge is great to have as it takes the guess work out of when to get a refill.  It heats up quickly and gets over 500 deg with just the two burners. The slide out grease tray is easy to access and cleans up well (if you stay on top of it).  I actually prefer the 2 burners over the 3 burners design.  (I have an older Genesis 3 burner model). Indirect cooking on the Spirit seems easier and more consistent. I suppose (if I had to find something I wasn't thrilled about) I would say that the red "Grill Symbols" on the burner controls would be easier if they were just red lines (as opposed to grill icon).  The icon is cute and all...but I just want a line to show me instantly what heat setting I am on.  A minor nit...I do so love this grill.
Results.Title: Grill that will Thrill

Results.ReviewText: I love this grill the tray is great to pull out and clean. I did cover the tray with foil in between uses. I had a use weber before given to me by my sister she had for years and it lasted a few more years with me. But this one is smaller and easier for 2 psople and a couple of guests.

Results.ReviewText: Easy to put together. Heats up quickly. Easily fits on a small deck. Only complaint is the grates are slightly too wide. I have lost a few hamburgers to the bottom when flipping them.

Results.ReviewText: This grill has many desirable upgrades compared to other brands in this price point. The cast main body is a huge improvement over sheet metal that rusts and/or welds separating over time. The concept of a removeable drip tray not only makes cleaning much easier, it also enables replacement when needed - this is another huge improvement that will enable this grill to easily outlast any competitor due to these two features. The wide slat grates make cooking easier by allowing non-stick sprays to coat better - making the chance of food sticking to the grill much less, not to mention the wide grill marks on food have a more professional grade appearance. Then add to that, a built in propane level meter. This is a very well designed grill and I'd suggest it to anyone who asks
Results.Title: Great features for a reasonable price

Results.ReviewText: At first I was a little skeptical of the Weber spirit II as it dint really seem any different than all the other grill except for its outstanding quality and build. This grill will last you several seasons. Then, I got the Weber craft griddle and accessories, and all I can say is wow. The griddle, once seasoned, is non-stick and evenly heats food. I made brinner (breakfast for dinner) and it was amazing. Total time to make pancakes, eggs, and ham was probably 15 minutes. I’m sure it took me longer to prep everything than actually cooking it. This has been such a godsend that most of my families meals are cooked on the grill/griddle. My wife hasn’t had to cook in weeks as I’m grilling daily! Really made my life easier.
Results.Title: Wow what a powerhouse

Results.ReviewText: Nice grill that’s fairly easy to assemble.  I think Weber might need to work on packaging a bit since mine arrived with a pretty bent up base (what the wheels get attached to), but luckily it’s fairly easy to straighten out with a food on the ground and the rest of the grill structure keeps it sound.  The cooking grates that come with it are hard to clean though and I replaced them as soon as I could.  The folding side shelves are great for storing!  Hiding the propane tank behind a door is wonderful and clean looking, and the propane tank scale is awesome for knowing about when a new tank is needed.

46110001.Description:
Taste the difference a Spirit will make in your life. With features such as porcelain enameled, cast-iron cooking grates that retain even heat, you’re guaranteed the best tasting food. It’s built to last with a cookbox that helps prevent rusting and peeling, and conveniently equipped with six tool hooks for easy accessibility of grilling tools. If that wasn’t enough, the low maintenance and easy-to-clean grease management system takes the hassle out of cooking. Designed to fit on a small patio or balcony, the Spirit E-210 gas grill brings grilling to any home.


• Durable, easy-to-clean porcelain-enamel cast iron grates.

• Porcelain-enameled finish helps prevent rusting and pealing.

• Six tool hooks for easy accessibility of grilling tools.

• Low maintenance and easy-to-clean grease management system.

• 360 square inches of main grilling space.


 This product requires assembly.
